document.about: Economic Report of the President, 2023 (513 pages). Every page carries a running chapter title and its number, and the charts repeat their labels and sources across pages, so many lines are furniture and several often stand together at a block's start or end. Pages of prose carry link underlines drawn as rules.

notes: Furniture was scrubbed from a block one pattern at a time, in the order a hash map gave them, and a pattern matched only at the block's end; two running lines together at the end both went only when the outer one was tried first. A column ruler was also chosen in that order where two ranks of rules tied. On the same binary, ten runs gave seven different Markdown readings: a chart's labels kept or cut, and a paragraph read whole or split.

checks.issue: Converted again, the same binary read chart labels and a paragraph differently.
